questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A side road intersects ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that a side road will cross your path ahead.

questions.question: A large truck ahead is turning right onto a street with two lanes in each direction. The truck:

options.text: May complete its turn in either of the two lanes.
May have to swing wide to complete the right turn.
Must stay in the right lane at all times while turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: May have to swing wide to complete the right turn.
questions.explanation: When turning, the rear wheels follow a shorter path than the front wheels. Long trucks need extra space to turn. They often swing wide to the left to complete a right turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Red, yellow, green.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: To help avoid skidding on slippery surfaces, you should:

options.text: Shift to a lower gear after starting down a steep hill.
Speed up to enter curves and slow down to exit them.
Slow down before entering curves and intersections.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering curves and intersections.
questions.explanation: Slow down before you enter a curve because you cannot see what is ahead. Braking while turning can cause you to skid.

questions.question: If weather or light conditions require you to have your lights on while driving:
questions.correctAnswerText: Use your low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, snow, or rain. High beams reflect light back at you, creating glare and making it harder to see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to a school zone. This sign shows where children or pedestrians may cross the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: A broken yellow centerline means that:

options.text: Passing on the right is permitted when the way ahead is clear.
Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline means you can cross it to pass another vehicle on the left if no traffic is coming. Never cross a solid yellow centerline to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs have a yellow-green background. They warn of upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns.

questions.question: To avoid losing traction on wet roads, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: To prevent losing control on wet roads, slow down and keep your tires in good condition. If you start to slide, release the gas, do not brake, keep the vehicle straight, and let it slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: Drivers must obey instructions from:

options.text: Other drivers with broken-down vehicles on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Flaggers at construction sites.
questions.explanation: Drivers must follow flaggers' instructions at construction sites. Flaggers keep drivers and workers safe.

questions.question: If your vehicle's rear skids to the left, you should:

options.text: Turn your steering wheel left to correct the skid.
Turn your steering wheel right to correct the skid.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel left to correct the skid.
questions.explanation: If you skid on a wet or icy road, take your foot off the gas and brakes. Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid. If you have anti-lock brakes, press the brakes firmly and steer straight.

questions.question: You hit a parked car and cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked vehicle, you must leave a note on it with your name, phone number, and address.

questions.question: If a tire suddenly blows out while driving, you should:

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and leave the traffic lane.
Brake hard and steer toward the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and leave the traffic lane.
questions.explanation: If a tire blows out, hold the steering wheel tight and remove your foot from the gas. Let the car slow down. Lightly apply the brakes when safe. Do not move to the shoulder until the car has slowed significantly.

questions.question: Traffic control devices in construction and maintenance areas are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Orange.
questions.explanation: Orange signs are used in work zones. Be extra careful when you see orange signs, cones, or barriers on the road.

questions.question: You are driving behind a motorcycle and want to pass. You must:

options.text: Stay in the right lane because the motorcycle is small and does not use the whole lane.
Honk your horn to make the motorcycle move to the shoulder so you can pass.
Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before and during the pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your entire vehicle into the left lane before and during the pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a motorcycle, give it a full lane. Never share the same lane as the motorcycle. Moving back too soon can force the rider to swerve right into traffic or off the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to conditions that may not be obvious. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending and warns you about merging traffic.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.
questions.explanation: In darkness or poor weather, increase your following distance. This gives you more time to react to hazards you cannot see.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is turning right and you also need to turn right, you should:

options.text: Turn quickly before the truck or bus does.
Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.

questions.question: If a tire blows out, what should you do?

options.text: Press the brake hard and keep it pressed.
Hold the steering wheel tight and brake gently.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tight and brake gently.
questions.explanation: When a tire blows out, grip the steering wheel firmly and keep the car straight. Slow down gradually by releasing the gas and braking lightly. Try not to stop on the road. Drive to a safe place off the road.

questions.question: What does a steady green traffic light mean?

options.text: You can go through if it is safe and clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can go through if it is safe and clear.
questions.explanation: A steady green light means you may drive through the intersection. Watch for other cars and pedestrians already in the intersection. Only go if the road is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let other cars safely merge into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that you are leaving a one-way road and will soon drive on a two-way road where traffic goes both directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other cars and pedestrians cross in front of you before you proceed. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad ahead.
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: Tired driving is dangerous. Take a break every hour on long trips. Share driving with another person so you can both rest.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Intersection coming up.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you of things ahead. This sign tells you an intersection is coming so you can prepare for other cars or turns.

questions.question: If your car has a two-part safety belt, how should you wear it?

options.text: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: Always wear both parts of a two-part seat belt. Using only one part does not protect you well. Even if you have an automatic shoulder belt, also buckle the lap belt.

questions.question: Which statement is true about alcohol and driving?

options.text: If you can walk straight after drinking, it is safe to drive.
If you are below the legal limit, your driving is not affected.
Alcohol hurts your judgment, which you need to drive safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol hurts your judgment, which you need to drive safely.
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your judgment. Good judgment is needed to respond quickly and safely to things on the road. Even small amounts of alcohol can harm your driving, even if you are below the legal limit.
